name: Fuji-Web
description: Chrome extension agent that understands a web page and carries out a user's instruction by clicking and typing on it.
whatItDoes: Lets a user type a goal in the extension panel and have it executed on the current site. It demonstrates a multimodal approach to web navigation for developers and researchers.
howItWorks: The extension annotates the page, sends a screenshot plus element labels to a multimodal model and performs the chosen action through browser debugging APIs, looping until done. It is installed by loading the packaged extension from the releases page.
